mapper.select: SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN l.id AS sourceId,l.projectId AS originalProjectId,canonical.projectId AS canonicalProjectId,p.projectCode AS originalProjectCode,current_project.compId AS originalCompanyId,current_project.projectName AS originalProjectName,p.column001 AS originalDepartmentCode,p.projectType,l.itemCode,l.itemName,l.projectQuantity,l.orderQuantity,l.deliverQuantity,l.openQuantity,l.orderNumber,l.lineNum FROM pm_project_product_line l JOIN pm_project p ON p.projectId=l.projectId JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS projectId FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) canonical ON canonical.typeKey=CAST(p.projectType AS BINARY) AND canonical.codeKey=CAST(p.projectCode AS BINARY) JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=canonical.projectId WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.projectType='10' ORDER BY l.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,compCode AS code FROM t_company LIMIT #{limit}
